218. Structure where a stronger one comes when one is taken down (5)
A huge darkness spread over the naval base of the Demon World.
Of course, Sakiel, and the demons of the Demon World facing that darkness under the base had never experienced Murakan's ultimate skill before.
What its power is, what will happen in the future. No demon could guess, but they felt instinctively. They were exposed to a terrible danger.
'I need to activate the shield... I have to activate it!'
Sakiel hastily shouted to spread the base's protective shield, but her voice merely echoed hollowly in her mouth.
Actually, it wasn't that her voice wasn't produced, but most of the demons who had to carry out her orders had already disappeared, consumed by the darkness.
They couldn't even realize the moment they died. Their vision just darkened for a moment, and consciousness was cut off in the instant they tried to act reflexively.

Numerous defensive equipment and boundary spells that the Demon World boasted were buried helplessly in the darkness. Sakiel, feeling the darkness approaching from the side and behind, was startled and tossed her body around.
'It's over with one touch...!'
Sakiel raised her crystal ball.
When she was a past great general, it was an intention to use a great seal that had suppressed countless Demon Kings except Zito.
"I will make you regret not stepping back gracefully!"
When Sakiel released her magical energy, the darkness around her cleared for a moment.
[Ho, so you're a top-ranking demon. Seems you have some roots.]
Murakan smirked and looked at Sakiel.
However, he did not specifically exert more pressure or breathe to restrain Sakiel further. The purpose of Jin and Murakan visiting here today was not to destroy the largest base of the Demon World.
It was to assess the extent of their power and how threatening their abilities were. For example, they had to check as many secret techniques possessed by the demons of the Demon World as possible.
Kwaaa…!

The sphere of magical energy surrounding Sakiel was spinning fiercely, pushing the darkness of Dark Advent even further. The speed was getting faster and faster, and Murakan revealed an interesting expression each time.
[You feel it too, kid? An enormous energy is being generated inside the magic hiding that demon. She seems to be trying to use some magic through the crystal ball.]
"You decide everything, Murakan. If it seems to be dangerous at all, attack without watching any further, or let's keep watching."

[It's impossible to be in danger now that your ultimate technique has been deployed so perfectly, Murakan. Of course, unless there's a monster that can tear through the darkness of Dark Advent. Like Elona Zipfel. Probably Zito and Phaelito Belgashium in the Demon World.]
In Murakan's view, Sakiel pushing away the darkness was merely a scratch on the surface of Dark Advent.
If Sakiel had the power of Creation, she would have already been attacking Murakan before Dark Advent fully unfolded.
Beneath the base, a silent massacre was continuing.
Through his senses spread across Dark Advent, Murakan felt the demons dying, and Jin confirmed that the energy of the demons beyond the darkness was rapidly disappearing one by one.
And Sakiel had secured her territory, about five times larger than before. On the surface of the enlarged magical energy sphere, numerous magical circles of an unfamiliar kind were being engraved.
"A curse, or it seems like a sealing line. But since we've confirmed immunity to curses, it's probably sealing."
[Whatever it is, he won't succeed.]
Jin nodded at Murakan's confident words.
At that moment, the spell of the Great Seal Sakiel had prepared was completed. Sakiel widened her eyes and focused all her magical power and energy on the crystal ball.
'The End of Hell, a spell that has sealed seven Demon Kings so far. No matter how powerful you are, you can't withstand this...!'
The End of Hell, a spell that made Sakiel, who was relatively weaker in combat power compared to the top generals, into a total service agency.

She had not anticipated unfolding this spell at the very start of the battle, but Sakiel felt rather fortunate. If Murakan could unfold True Dark Advent every time without any consequences, it would be right to finish it off here and now.
"I'll send you to hell!"

Sakiel raised the crystal ball with a scream. If everything went according to plan, all the souls of Hell that Sakiel had collected so far would have sprung from that crystal ball, capturing Jin and Murakan. They would have been thrown into an abyss beyond the calculation of past Demon Kings.
However, moments later, Sakiel realized that the magical circles engraved on the crystal ball weren't activating.
'What's this, there wasn't a single error in the spell. But why isn't it activating.'
[Ha ha ha!]
At that moment, Murakan burst out laughing. The darkness of Dark Advent seemed to ripple with the laughter, as if mocking Sakiel together.
"The moment that bastard was preparing his magic, my spiritual energy had already infiltrated the crystal ball. It seems he completed the spell without realizing it because he was in a hurry."
"Indeed, it was a sealing system. If it wasn't blocked in advance, it would have been a dangerous magic. With that much power, neither you nor I could have easily shrugged it off."
"I hate to admit it, but that's true. If the sealing ceremony unfolded without a hitch, we both would've had to dig deep to barely pull through. He's quite a character, that Sakiel."
Sakiel faced the crystal ball, which had been stained black belatedly.
A beginner-level mistake she couldn't believe herself. Since learning magic, Sakiel had never made such a mistake.
The reason why Sakiel didn't notice the spiritual energy that had infiltrated the crystal ball was nothing else.

As Murakan said, it was because she didn't have any room to spare. If she wanted to solve this situation 'on her own', there was only one option left, 'The End of Hell', so she tried to complete the spell by any means.

To push back the encroaching darkness and unfold the spell, she couldn't pay attention to anything else. She was so focused that she couldn't even check the condition of the crystal ball right in front of her.
"Kahak!"
The darkness of Dark Advent swallowed Sakiel's right hand holding the crystal ball. The darkness tore the crystal ball and her right hand at once, continuing to surge towards Sakiel.
[If you do well, you could deal with that guy and go back before Dark Advent ends, kid.]
"Complacency is forbidden until the end. But it is tempting to finish off the Chief Secretary of the Demon Realm here. I guess it's time for me to draw my sword."
As Bradamante slipped out of the sheath, it was wrapped in spiritual energy. Sakiel was barely flying to avoid Dark Advent.
If Jin intervenes now, Sakiel will face death.
However, Sakiel had one last remaining move.
'In the end... Do I have to use Lord Zito's true technique?'
The problem was that it was Zito's power, not her own.

Sakiel didn't ponder for long. It was already permitted to draw on Zito's power in anticipation of such a situation. This was a privilege granted only to Phaelito, Sakiel, and a few high-ranking demons.
Sakiel took out a black lump the size of a finger from her pocket.
Zito's flesh. It was something she had intended to use when she encountered Genesis during the Inse invasion. Even in such moments, it was something she never wanted to use if possible.

Using Zito's flesh 'consumes' it, which meant permanently weakening Zito. Even if it's just one piece of flesh, the value of its power when returned to Zito and when used by another demon were worlds apart.
'I'm sorry, Lord Zito.'
Then Sakiel, with tears in her eyes, squeezed the piece of flesh in her hand. The moment the flesh crumbled like a walnut, Jin stopped his swinging sword and gathered his energy.
He realized that the situation had rapidly reversed from attack to defense.
"Murakan, he's pulled out a new move. And this is... Zito's energy."
[Yeah, it's the power of that guy who was beaten by Ayula.]
The energy wrapping Sakiel was pushed back.

Sakiel was wielding a power at a similar level to Zito when he was facing Ayula. Her torn arm had already regenerated, pushing back the encroaching darkness, and a new magic formed a sphere in place of the disappeared crystal ball.
In that sphere, the sealing ritual that Sakiel was just about to unfold was being reformed. At the same time, offensive dark magic was pouring down, a force not even Jin and Murakan could ignore.
Jin blocked the dark rays with his sword, and Murakan spread his wings, amplifying the darkness of the Dark Advent.
"Murakan, let's retreat."

[Retreat? Even though she's become incredibly strong by drawing on Zito's power, her condition doesn't look good. It seems like she's going berserk. She definitely can't maintain this state for long.]

"That's why we have to retreat. I don't think we can handle the sealing ritual combined with Zito's power for now, and as you say, Sakiel's enhancement won't last forever. We retreat and wait for Zito's power to wane."
[I also forced myself to implement the Dark Advent of the heyday. You know I need a recovery period to fight at the same level as now if we retreat and come back, right?]

"Even so, it doesn't matter. Beyond that, we're already ahead even if we don't fight Sakiel again today. The power of Zito that Sakiel used will certainly be lost. If it was a type of power that wouldn't be lost, there would be no reason to pull it out now. The cost of this battle for us is just you needing some recovery, but they can never recover what they used today."
[Hmph, fine. Then before we retreat, I guess I need to spread the remnants of the Dark Advent towards the garrison.]

Murakan then focused the Dark Advent towards the garrison, a malicious smile on his face. Sakiel tried to chase after Jin and Murakan, but when she confirmed the destruction of the garrison, she stopped flying.
Zito's flesh, which the demon realm's leaders, including Sakiel, cherished like their lives, was used to protect the garrison and disappeared.
